ai.seo_question: What is the condition for entering a woman's private chambers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi underscores the legal necessity of obtaining permission from a woman's wali (guardian) before entering her private quarters, reflecting the broader Shia jurisprudence on privacy and social decorum. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the rights of women in domestic spaces and the hierarchical structure of familial authority within the household.

en.hubeali: ‘(He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The entering one should not enter the (chambers of) women except with the permission of their guardians’.
en.sarwar: 2. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: “Men must not enter the place of women without the permission of their guardian.”
